_meta.description: Content-block fixtures for the VCST-4933 Page Builder SHARED COMPONENTS test-data set (master page, linked-placement consumer pages, Draft consumer, A/B control page, and the four shared components). JSON-shaped to the two live API bodies: POST /api/page-builder-shared-components { storeId, name, content:{settings,content[]} } and POST /api/page-builder-pages/grouped/{groupId}/content { settings, content[] }. Applied by scripts/seed-data/cms/seed-pagebuilder-shared-components.mjs; block ids are assigned deterministically at build time (never platform GUIDs).
_meta.block_types: ONLY the LOWERCASE rendering block types this theme has renderers for: title {heading,title,subtitle} | text {text}. A capitalised "Text" block is accepted by the REST API and renders BLANK on the storefront (measured 2026-09-16 on /agent-test-q5-plain: 6 x "Text" -> empty content area, zero console errors, very nearly mis-filed as a Critical product bug). The types here are copied from a page PROVEN to render: /qa-homepage-spring-sale.
_meta.placement_marker: { "ref": "<COMPONENT_ALIAS>" } inside a page's content[] is a SEED-TIME marker, not an API shape. buildPageContentBody() replaces it with the real linked placement: a top-level item with EXACTLY three keys {id,type:"componentRef",componentRef:<runtime component id>}. A type:"section" item merely carrying a componentRef property is an ordinary section and is inert.
_meta.divergence: .claude/rules/test-data.md SECOND RULE. Every section text is DISTINCT so a drop/reorder/partial-expansion is observable: master ALPHA..ECHO (5, so a 3-adjacent selection leaves one unselected section on EACH side), shared trio ONE/TWO/THREE, per-page own TOP/BOTTOM texts that name their own page. Equal texts on two sides of a distinction under test would make the case vacuous.
_meta.source: Block shapes transcribed from the live delivered content of /qa-homepage-spring-sale (vcptcore-qa, 2026-09-16).
